checks.title: Confirm payable review goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name legal entity, intake owner, AP reviewer, payment authority, first useful result, and excluded actions. Decide whether one Crew can hold both capabilities or access requires two.

checks.title: Bind authorized invoice source
checks.instructions: Record document ID, immutable hash, version, allowed type, storage location, retention/privacy policy, source page convention and review owner. Do not move a sensitive document to an unapproved service.

checks.title: Define required fields and arithmetic
checks.instructions: Confirm vendor ID, invoice number, dates, currency, net, tax, total, PO/contract reference rule, source spans and tolerance. A missing or conflicting required field stays in review.

checks.title: Define duplicate, credit and payment rules
checks.instructions: Set exact and near-duplicate keys, current bill/credit/payment sources, already scheduled and paid states, approval matrix, changed bank-detail escalation and due-date policy.

checks.title: Bind ready intake and payables Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Crew skills, owners and access. Reuse compatible Document Intake Assistant and Spend & Payables Coordinator capabilities or propose reviewed creation. Record exact Crew IDs.

checks.title: Probe one real invoice and payable source
checks.instructions: Read an authorized document version and current vendor/bill records. Record stable source IDs, observed timestamps and missing coverage. A named connection alone is not access proof.

checks.title: Validate the extraction and payable join
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator on document-intake-record/v1 before Payables consumes it, then on payable-review/v1. Reject wrong entity, hash or invoice key; unsupported fields; arithmetic mismatch; duplicate or paid bill represented as new; and a payment claim without provider evidence.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation and permissions
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and artifact paths, validator steps, owner decision, retry key, privacy and cost, manual route, and separate approval plus provider receipt required for any write or payment.

checks.title: Run one invoice manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized invoice and current AP records. Save run, validation, duplicate result, owner corrections, review state and provider receipts or none. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose a safe repeat rule
checks.instructions: Record document hash, vendor and invoice key, existing bill ID, approvals and next review. Choose manual-only or a reviewed authenticated document event/cadence with replay protection, retries, cost and notifications. Setup completion does not enable a payment.
